==Transportation==
* [[Drakan's medallion]] provides unlimited teleports directly to Ver Sinhaza. The medallion is locked behind the completion of [[A Taste of Hope]] quest.
* Players may pay 10,000 coins to [[Andras]] north of the [[Ectofuntus]] in [[Port Phasmatys]] to travel to [[Slepe]], then run south from there. Players can also use an [[Ectophial]] to travel to the [[Ectofuntus]] and run south from there.
* After starting [[Darkness of Hallowvale]], players can take the boat from [[Burgh de Rott]] to the [[Meiyerditch]] beach and walk to the Theatre without having to navigate through the city.
